inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped report pivots period-labelled rows into one result row per entity with one MAX(CASE WHEN period = ...) expression per period, allowing missing period values to remain NULL.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a regional performance snapshot with new table names, periods, measures, and rows. Each region reports its best score for each quarter through conditional MAX aggregates; a missing quarter remains NULL and duplicate snapshots are resolved by MAX rather than assumed to be unique.

fixture_notes: North has two Q1 snapshots and one Q2 snapshot but no Q3 snapshot. South has one Q1 snapshot, two Q2 snapshots, and one Q3 snapshot. MAX chooses the higher duplicate-period score and missing periods produce NULL cells.
determinism_notes: Region labels, period labels, scores, grouping key, pivot columns, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE regional_score_snapshots (snapshot_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, period_code VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, score INT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT region_code, MAX(CASE WHEN period_code = 'Q1' THEN score ELSE NULL END) AS q1_best_score, MAX(CASE WHEN period_code = 'Q2' THEN score ELSE NULL END) AS q2_best_score, MAX(CASE WHEN period_code = 'Q3' THEN score ELSE NULL END) AS q3_best_score FROM regional_score_snapshots GROUP BY region_code ORDER BY region_code

checks.sql: SELECT snapshot_id, region_code, period_code, score FROM regional_score_snapshots ORDER BY snapshot_id
